content:
Hi, I am making my first PR at https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/42043 and wanted to ask for feedback. I tried to keep it really short and put off any theorems about the Suzuki groups into subsequent requests since I noticed people really want to keep each PR short.

I already got bitten once by using dsimp and then a version bump breaking my code. Hopefully the rest of it is robust.

Stylistically we have stuff which is pretty specific to this group which is not marked as protected. Does this clutter Loogle if people search for the Weyl group and find my lemmas about a generator in GL(4, F_q)?
Thanks for the feedback, people are right and we need to formalize this in a better way. Matrices seemed like a good starting point but this is a dead end.
